top_signals.title: Ukraine Hits Refinery as Moscow Prepares to Extend Diesel Export Ban
top_signals.summary: Ukraine hit overnight an oil refinery near Moscow, damaging a processing plant co-owned by Rosneft and Gazprom Neft, as Russia prepares to extend its ban on diesel exports through the end of October. In a sign that Ukraine and Russia have not agreed on any partial truce not to strike energy infrastructure, Ukraine's forces hit with drones the refinery in Yaroslavl, while Russia attacked infrastructure in Kyiv. The 300,000-barrels-per-day refinery in Yaroslavl, fewer than 200 miles northeast of Moscow, was hit overnight with drones in a joint operation…

top_signals.title: Odd Lots: What Happens When Billionaires Turn to Politics
top_signals.summary:
What happens when simply getting rich is not enough and billionaires continue to strive for something greater?

Stanford Professor Francis Fukuyama joins Tracy Alloway and Joe Weisenthal on the Odd Lots podcast to discuss what drives the richest and most powerful people in the world and what happens when their ambitions get entangled with politics. (Source: Bloomberg)

top_signals.title: Activities of U.S. Affiliates of Foreign Multinational Enterprises, 2024
top_signals.summary: Majority-owned U.S. affiliates of foreign multinational enterprises employed 8.57 million workers in the United States in 2024, a 0.2 percent increase from 8.56 million workers in 2023, according to statistics on U.S. affiliate operations and finances released today by the U.S. Bureau of Economic Analysis.
